faqs.question: Which companies visit Parul University for campus placements?
faqs.answer: Various national and international companies participate in campus recruitment each year. The list of recruiters varies depending on the placement season and industry requirements.

faqs.question: Can students from all branches participate in placements?
faqs.answer: Placement opportunities are available for eligible students from different programs, depending on company-specific eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Does the university provide resume-building support?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Training and Placement Cell conducts resume-building sessions and provides guidance to help students prepare professional resumes.

faqs.question: Are mock interviews conducted before placements?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mock interviews are organized to help students improve their interview skills and confidence before campus recruitment.

faqs.question: Does the university conduct aptitude training?
faqs.answer: Yes. Aptitude training sessions are conducted to prepare students for campus recruitment tests.

faqs.question: Are communication skills training sessions provided?
faqs.answer: Yes. The university organizes communication and soft skills development sessions to improve employability.

faqs.question: Does Parul University help students prepare for HR interviews?
faqs.answer: Yes. Placement training programs include HR interview preparation and personality development sessions.

faqs.question: Can students apply to multiple companies during placements?
faqs.answer: Students may apply to multiple companies according to the placement policy and eligibility conditions announced by the university.

faqs.question: What documents should I carry for campus interviews?
faqs.answer: Students should carry their resume, university identity card, academic documents, passport-size photographs, and any other documents requested by the recruiter.

faqs.question: Will I receive placement notifications through ERP or email?
faqs.answer: Placement announcements are communicated through official university communication channels such as ERP, email, or the Training and Placement Cell.

faqs.question: Does the university organize campus recruitment drives?
faqs.answer: Yes. The university regularly organizes campus recruitment drives with participating companies.

faqs.question: Can students from previous batches participate in placements?
faqs.answer: Eligibility for alumni or previous batch placements depends on the university's placement policy and recruiter requirements.

faqs.question: Does the university conduct technical interview preparation sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Technical preparation sessions are organized for eligible students according to their discipline and placement requirements.

faqs.question: Are coding practice sessions organized before placements?
faqs.answer: For relevant programs, coding practice sessions and technical workshops may be conducted to prepare students for recruitment processes.

faqs.question: Can I update my resume after placement registration?
faqs.answer: Resume updates are generally allowed before company-specific application deadlines, subject to placement portal policies.

faqs.question: Does the university provide career counseling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Career counseling sessions are organized to help students make informed decisions regarding employment and higher education.

faqs.question: Can I participate in off-campus placement opportunities?
faqs.answer: Students may participate in off-campus opportunities independently or through university-supported initiatives where applicable.

faqs.question: Does the university provide placement statistics?
faqs.answer: Placement statistics and recruitment highlights are published through official university communication channels.

faqs.question: Can higher studies students also participate in placements?
faqs.answer: Eligible postgraduate students may participate in campus placements based on recruiter requirements and university policies.

faqs.question: How do I contact the Training and Placement Cell?
faqs.answer: Students can contact the Training and Placement Cell through the official university contact channels for placement-related assistance.
